resolution: Clarified the modifier finding: modifiers WORK in the app — keyboard events pack SDL mod state into the payload ((mod<<32)|sym, decoded to shiftKey/ctrlKey/altKey/metaKey in runtime/hooks/useIFTTT.ts decodeKey:357, which is why Ctrl/Shift keyboard chords work cart-wide), and native Zig paths read SDL_GetModState directly (mesh-editor marquee, loop-cut snap). The gap is ONE junction: mouse/pointer events delivered to JS (runtime/index.tsx getPointerPayload:385) never had modifier fields added and no host getter exposes mod state for clicks — so shift+CLICK specifically is dead while shift+key works. It is a never-connected wire, not a broken modifier system; fix = one host getter + one payload field + rebuild. No code changed.
